summary: Real factory /readyz observes app.state.organism_scheduler; removes dead global-engine reference and raw exception exposure.
PostgreSQL100ms and Redis200ms outcomes distinguish actual expired budget, dependency exception, false return and success; historical broker key preserved with explicit Redis component.
Dependency observations cached2s with stable measured_at/monotonic cache age; runtime rechecked each request. Scheduler observational clocks do not influence scheduling or trading.
Enabled missing/stopped/uninitialized/brain-unloaded or stale runtime returns503. Market-closed exempts tick recency only; loop must stay fresh. Bounded first-tick grace explicitly warming_up.
Watchdog preserves typed allowlisted dependency/runtime diagnostics and legacy response support without adding restart authority.

Read-only critical log scans page oldest time windows without suffix-tail, advance cursor only across complete windows, split truncated intervals, preserve pending fingerprints/counts and expose backlog. Owned CLI is byte/time bounded and reaped.
